static_traits.name: Chen Kai
static_traits.social_status: The relationship with wife and children is strained by Work pressure and worries about binge eating/obesity; having a supportive wife, but not yet discussing related worries with her
static_traits.medical_history: No similar problems before; never received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, Good cooperativeness; Neutral attitude; able to clearly describe the stress-hunger cycle; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I constantly feel hungry and worry about becoming fat from binge eating.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because concerns about binge eating and weight gain have begun to affect my mental health and family life. I really want to sort this matter out, for myself and for my family.
growth_experiences: In recent years, stress rose from moderate due to increased Work hours and Financial worries; feeling hungry and insecure every day after high-pressure Work days; tried various diet and exercise plans but hunger persists; not yet discussing weight and binge-eating worries with his supportive wife, Family relationships thus affected.

core_beliefs: I cannot control my own eating

special_situations.event: After a very stressful workday, upon returning home, strong hunger appears
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I eat a lot when hungry, I will definitely gain weight quickly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to distract attention or eat only small amounts of food, striving to control outcomes with various diet and exercise plans
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If this goes on, I am sure I will become obese

special_situations.event: The phase of Work load and financial Increased stress
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: When stress is high, my hunger becomes uncontrollable; uncontrollable hunger inevitably leads to binge eating and obesity
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tightening Self-monitoring of diet and exercise, avoiding talking with wife to avoid 'adding burden'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, I will end up fat

special_situations.event: After eating more on some days to relieve intense hunger
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once I overeat, it shows I am heading toward irreversible obesity
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-blame, intensified control plans (stricter diet or exercise)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I messed things up; I will get fatter and fatter

special_situations.event: Afternoon work becomes very busy, continuously feels hungry before returning home
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I will stay this hungry, the future will definitely bring fatness
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses preemptive dietary restriction or distraction to suppress the hunger
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Following this trend, I will inevitably become obese

core_conflict.wish: Longs to have control over body and diet, and to maintain family stability and a sense of being supported
core_conflict.fear: Fears losing control leading to obesity, being judged, or adding burden to family
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of safety through self-control and restrained expression, avoiding letting the partner 'bear my problems'

object_relations.self_representation: A worrier who will burden others / a person who needs self-restraint
object_relations.object_representation: A supportive partner who may be dragged down by my problems

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about whether to express worries about binge eating and weight to his wife, or when invited to discuss this problem with family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to think expressing his worries will burden his wife, therefore should not say it
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Affirming his considerate intent toward family in a gentle, Empathic tone, while softly exploring the real cost and evidence of 'not telling'; using open-ended questions, avoiding confrontation, inviting him to envision safer communication and boundaries.

manifestations: Not sharing worries with his supportive wife, choosing to bear it alone for fear of 'adding burden'
Struggles alone in the cycle of stress - hunger - eating - guilt
Feels constrained by work and financial pressure; experiences loss of control over hunger and eating
Seeing the future as unavoidable obesity, experiencing Restricted choices

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Worrying about 'adding burden' and not expressing pressure and worries to his wife
Turns emotional energy toward stricter self-control (diet/exercise)

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: Trying to distract rather than directly contact and explore feelings during intense hunger and Anxiety
Uses skillful avoidance to briefly override hunger and worry

positive_force: Having family support (wife supportive and willing to Listen)
Has proactively sought psychological counseling help, with high motivation to change (for self and family)
Having some Self-monitoring and agency (tried various diet and exercise plans)
Able to identify the stress-hunger-eating-guilt cycle
negative_force: Strong catastrophic and future-predicting cognitive patterns (believing fatness is inevitable)
Overgeneralization and mental filtering (ignoring positive evidence)
Work and financial stress staying high long-term, triggering hunger and Anxiety
Avoiding communication with the partner leading to support resources not yet fully utilized
Guilt intensifies after eating, further consolidating the negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Overeating after high-pressure workdays (to relieve intense hunger)
antecedent: Persistent intense hunger before returning home
target_behavior.core_reason: Work and financial stress lead to increased physical and emotional hunger; accompanied by the catastrophic cognition 'eating more will definitely make me fat', self-control declines
target_behavior.function: Avoiding/relieving stress and hunger discomfort, gaining brief physical and emotional relief
target_behavior.consequence: Producing Strong guilt and worry after eating, further intensifying Fear of obesity and Tense family relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophically predicting she will inevitably become fat with strong Anxiety
antecedent: When self-Reflecting after eating a lot
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief 'I cannot control my diet / I will become obese' is triggered, negative automatic thoughts dominate
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain control over uncertainty through high vigilance and self-restraint
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety and Rising stress, intensified hunger experience, forming a stress-hunger-eating-guilt vicious cycle
